title: Backend Java Software Developer
description:
**About the Role:**
===================

**Grade Level (for internal use):**

09

**The Role:** Backend Java Software Developer

**The Team**

A full-scale microservices transformation of the S&P Global’s Financial Risk Analytics product, pre-AI, was expected to require a large pool of technology roles across architecture, engineering, platform, security, operations, and delivery.

For the initial FRA prototype transformation, we want to stand up a lean, generative-AI enabled transformation squad with a focused team structure sized to deliver a validated microservices foundation.

The objective is to establish an agile technology transformation group to design and deliver a commercially aligned, targeted microservices architecture for the FRA platform, prioritizing measurable business outcomes and rapid learnings.

  

**Responsibilities and Impact:**

**Backend Engineer (Microservices Transformation)**
---------------------------------------------------

* Play a central role in building the organisation’s next-generation digital platform, developing microservices and backend components that power interactive and near-real-time customer experiences.
* Design and deliver high-quality domain microservices, REST/ GraphQL APIs, and event-driven integrations that enable scalable, decoupled, and future-ready systems.
* Engineer robust asynchronous workflows and event consumers/producers, helping create resilient services that perform reliably in complex distributed environments.
* Own the design and optimisation of service-owned data stores, supporting performance, scalability, and the successful migration of data from legacy monolithic platforms.
* Drive engineering excellence through unit testing, integration testing, performance tuning, and active code review, ensuring every release meets high standards of quality and maintainability.
* Contribute to operational confidence by monitoring live services, resolving incidents, and continuously improving observability to support secure, stable, and high-performing production systems.
  

**What We’re Looking For:**

  

**Basic Required Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related discipline; equivalent professional experience may also be considered.
* 5 to 9 years of work experience developing backend applications and microservices using **Java and Spring Boot** .
* Generative AI Development & Integration (Microservices and APIs)
* Scala, Java / Spring Boot and/ or .NET and / or Python
* SQL / NoSQL/ Cassandra/ HBase/ Spark/ Yarn
* Docker
* Git

**Key soft skills**
-------------------

* **Collaborative problem-solving** — Success in a microservices environment depends on working effectively across engineering, product, platform, and architecture teams. This role needs someone who can solve issues collectively, contribute constructively in design discussions, and build strong technical partnerships.
* **Ownership and accountability** — The strongest candidates take responsibility for service quality end to end, from build and test through to production support. They are proactive, dependable, and committed to resolving issues rather than handing them off.
* **Adaptability and learning agility** — Modernisation programs evolve quickly, especially when integrating with legacy platforms and near-real-time systems. This role requires someone who can absorb new domain knowledge fast, adapt to changing priorities, and remain effective in a fast-moving environment.
* **Attention to quality and operational discipline** — Building backend services is not just about writing code; it requires a mindset of precision, reliability, and continuous improvement. The individual should care deeply about testing, performance, observability, and building services that are resilient in production.
  

**Additional Preferred Qualifications:**

**Additional key qualifications for the job**
---------------------------------------------

* Kubernetes
* Big data technology(Spark, Hadoop etc)
* Event streaming
* Cloud-native development

**Additional soft skills**
--------------------------

* **Systems thinking** — In Kubernetes, messaging, and event-streaming environments, issues rarely sit in one component. Engineers need to understand how services, containers, infrastructure, queues, events, and data flows interact so they can anticipate downstream impact, design more resilient solutions, and troubleshoot effectively across the whole system rather than just their own code.
* **Clear technical communication** — Cloud-native and event-driven architectures create more service boundaries, contracts, and operational dependencies. Engineers must communicate clearly with platform teams, other service owners, and product stakeholders to avoid misunderstanding around APIs, event schemas, ownership, deployment changes, and incident response.
* **Adaptability and continuous learning** — Kubernetes, cloud-native practices, and distributed integration patterns evolve quickly, and real-world implementations often differ from ideal architecture. The role needs someone who can learn fast, absorb new patterns, and adjust to changing tooling, operating models, and migration realities without losing delivery momentum.
* **Operational composure and resilience** — Distributed systems fail in more complex ways: delayed messages, replay issues, scaling problems, noisy alerts, and intermittent production faults. Engineers need to stay calm under pressure, work methodically through ambiguity, and make sound decisions during incidents to protect service reliability and business continuity.

title: Backend Operations Manager
description:
About the Role

We are looking for a responsible and organized Backend Operations Manager to manage daily business operations, handle customer orders, coordinate order processing, and ensure smooth communication with customers. The ideal candidate should be proactive, detail-oriented, and capable of keeping track of what’s happening across the business backend.

Key Responsibilities

\* Order Management: Monitor incoming orders, verify order details, and ensure timely processing and dispatch.

\* Customer Support: Communicate with customers via chat, respond to queries, resolve basic issues, and provide order updates.

\* Backend Operations: Oversee daily backend activities and ensure all operational tasks are completed smoothly.

\* Order Tracking: Monitor shipments, delivery status, delays, cancellations, and return-to-origin (RTO) cases.

\* Business Monitoring: Keep track of daily orders, pending tasks, customer issues, and operational performance.

\* Coordination: Work with the team, warehouse, and logistics partners to resolve order-related issues.

\* Reporting: Maintain daily reports of orders, dispatches, cancellations, returns, and customer complaints.

\* Problem-Solving: Identify operational issues and take timely action to prevent delays and improve efficiency.

Requirements

\* Good communication skills in written English and Hindi.

\* Basic knowledge of Shopify or other e-commerce platforms is preferred.

\* Familiarity with Excel or Google Sheets.

\* Strong organizational and multitasking skills.

\* Ability to handle customers professionally over chat.

\* Responsible, proactive, and attentive to detail.

\* Previous experience in e-commerce operations or customer support is a plus.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

\* Timely order processing and dispatch.

\* Fast and professional customer responses.

\* Reduction in order errors, cancellations, and RTO.

\* Accurate order and shipment tracking.

\* Daily reporting and timely resolution of pending issues.

What We’re Looking For

Someone who takes ownership of the backend, keeps everything organized, communicates well with customers, and ensures that no order or operational issue goes unnoticed.

Pay: ₹180,000.00 - ₹204,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Paid sick time
* Paid time off

title: Architect, Backend Cloud Platform
description:

====================

**Position Overview**

The Full Stack is a senior hands-on technical role for candidates with 8–10 years of experience in enterprise application development, solution architecture and Azure cloud engineering. * 60–70% involvement in coding activity using C#, .NET Framework, .NET Core / modern .NET, REST APIs and related backend technologies.
* Hands-on experience with React JS, SQL Server, Entity Framework, microservices architecture, CI/CD and production-grade deployments.
* Deep knowledge of Azure Cloud is mandatory; exposure to AI code assistance tools such as GitHub Copilot is preferred.

**Application Architecture & Azure Cloud**

* Define high-level and low-level designs for .NET applications, APIs, microservices and integrations.
* Architect Azure-based solutions using services such as App Service, Azure Functions, Azure SQL, Storage, Key Vault, API Management and Service Bus.
* Ensure reliability, scalability, security, performance, observability and cost optimisation across application architecture.
* Have experience in web application development like React JS , Angular etc.

* Build, review and maintain CI/CD pipelines for .NET and React JS applications.
* Support automated deployments, blue-green / canary release patterns and environment governance.
* Collaborate on infrastructure as code using Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, Terraform.
* Use containerisation concepts such as Docker and Kubernetes where applicable for cloud-native workloads.
* Support automation using PowerShell, C#, Python or scripting tools as required.
* Monitor and troubleshoot applications using Azure Monitor, Application Insights, logs, metrics and traces.

* Implement secure coding practices, authentication, authorisation, secrets management and data protection controls.
* Use Azure Key Vault, Managed Identity, Microsoft Entra ID and secure configuration practices where applicable.
* Align application design with security, compliance, reliability and cloud governance expectations.
* Support responsible use of AI-assisted development tools with quality checks, code reviews and secure engineering guardrails.

* Participate in sprint ceremonies, technical planning, estimation, and delivery of quality reporting.
* Support story grooming, solutioning, impact analysis and technical risk identification at sprint level.

* Mentor developers on .NET, React JS, Azure, API design, microservices and engineering best practices.
* Collaborate with product owners, business analysts, QA, DevOps, security and architecture stakeholders.

* Strong fundamentals in C#, .NET Framework, .NET Core / modern .NET, OOP and software design principles.
* Strong hands-on experience with Azure services including App Service, Azure Functions, Azure SQL, Storage, Key Vault, API Management, Service Bus, Azure Monitor and Application Insights.
* Experience with SQL Server, Entity Framework / Entity Framework Core, database design, query optimisation and transactional systems.
* Experience building and consuming RESTful APIs with clear contracts, versioning, security and documentation standards.
* Working knowledge of React JS for frontend application development and backend integration.
* Proficiency in microservices architecture, distributed systems, design patterns and scalable application design.
* Experience building and managing CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, Jenkins or similar platforms.
* Familiarity with observability, secure coding, automated testing, static code analysis and production support practices.

* Exposure to Docker, Kubernetes, Azure Kubernetes Service, event-driven architecture and message-based integrations.
* Familiarity with Microsoft Entra ID, OAuth / OpenID Connect, Azure API Management and enterprise identity patterns.

* Strong analytical mindset, architecture thinking, and hands-on problem-solving ability.

* High attention to detail with a passion for code quality, maintainability and secure delivery.
* Ability to work independently while technically leading a cross-functional Agile team.

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Electronics, Electrical Engineering or equivalent experience.

description:
**Backend Developer / Data Engineer**

**Location:** Hapur, Uttar Pradesh, India  
**Work Arrangement:** On\-site  
**Contract:** Full\-time

**About GCRS Group**

GCRS Group is a global regulatory consultancy supporting businesses operating across cosmetics, fragrance, personal care, food supplements, medical devices and other regulated consumer products.

Our work spans regulatory compliance, product safety, responsible person services, market access, product stewardship, brand protection and technology\-enabled compliance solutions across international markets including the UK, USA, India, Europe, GCC/UAE and other global markets.

As our technology and digital capabilities continue to grow, we are looking for a **Backend Developer / Data Engineer** to join our India\-based technology team and help develop reliable systems, data infrastructure and backend services that support our internal operations and technology platforms.

**The Role**

You will be responsible for developing, maintaining and improving backend applications, APIs, databases and data pipelines used across GCRS technology platforms and internal systems.

The role combines **backend software development and data engineering**, making it suitable for someone who enjoys building robust systems while also working with structured data, integrations, automation and reporting.

You will work closely with developers, product stakeholders and business teams to understand requirements and translate them into scalable technical solutions.

This is a hands\-on role in a growing environment where you will have the opportunity to contribute to architecture, development standards, automation and the improvement of our overall technology infrastructure.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Design, develop and maintain backend applications and services
* Develop secure and reliable APIs and integrations
* Build and maintain databases and data models
* Develop data pipelines for collecting, transforming and processing information
* Integrate internal systems and third\-party services through APIs
* Write clean, maintainable and well\-documented code
* Optimise backend performance, database queries and system reliability
* Develop automated processes for data handling and operational workflows
* Support the development of reporting and analytics infrastructure
* Ensure data accuracy, consistency and integrity
* Identify and resolve backend and data\-related issues
* Conduct testing, debugging and performance improvements
* Work with frontend developers to support application functionality
* Collaborate with AI and technology teams where backend or data infrastructure is required
* Maintain appropriate technical documentation
* Support deployment and ongoing maintenance of applications
* Monitor systems and investigate technical issues
* Follow appropriate security and data\-protection practices
* Contribute to technical architecture and development standards
* Continuously identify opportunities to improve automation and efficiency

**What We Are Looking For**

We are looking for someone who is technically strong, analytical and comfortable working across backend development and data.

You should enjoy solving problems, understanding how systems work and building reliable solutions rather than simply completing individual coding tasks.

You will need to be comfortable working independently while also collaborating closely with other technology and business teams.

**Essential Experience and Skills**

* Experience in backend development, software engineering or data engineering
* Strong knowledge of at least one backend programming language such as Python, Java, Node.js or similar
* Strong understanding of databases and SQL
* Experience developing APIs and system integrations
* Understanding of data structures and data modelling
* Experience working with relational databases
* Understanding of data pipelines and ETL/ELT processes
* Good understanding of software development principles
* Experience with Git and version control
* Strong debugging and problem\-solving skills
* Understanding of application security and data protection
* Ability to understand business requirements and translate them into technical solutions
* Strong attention to detail
* Ability to document technical work clearly
* Ability to work independently and meet deadlines

**Desirable Experience**

* Python\-based data engineering and development of data processing pipelines.
* PostgreSQL, MySQL or similar relational database technologies.
* Cloud platforms such as AWS, Microsoft Azure or Google Cloud.
* Docker for application containerization and deployment.
* Data warehouses, business intelligence systems or analytics platforms.
* Automation and workflow tools used for streamlining data and operational processes.
* AI/ML systems and their integration with data engineering workflows.
* Handling large, complex or high\-volume datasets.
* SaaS, consultancy, technology or professional services environments.

**What Success Will Look Like**

Within your first six months, you will have:

* Developed and maintained reliable backend services
* Improved the performance and stability of existing systems
* Established effective data pipelines and database structures
* Delivered APIs and integrations required by the business
* Improved data quality and accessibility
* Reduced manual data\-processing requirements
* Worked effectively with frontend, AI and business teams
* Contributed to better technical documentation and development standards
* Helped create a stronger and more scalable technology foundation for GCRS

**Why Join Us?**

This is an opportunity to join a growing international business where technology is increasingly important to how we operate and deliver services.

You will have the opportunity to work on meaningful internal and client\-facing technology projects and contribute directly to the development of systems that support an international regulatory business.

**Important:** This is a **fully on\-site role based at the GCRS office in Hapur, Uttar Pradesh**. Candidates must be willing to **work from the Hapur office five days a week**.
